title: COVER YOUR MORNING WITH GOD'S PROTECTION
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. Don't just listen and walk away. There are people in your network, in your family, in your workplace that need the kind of covering we are about to invoke this morning. The Bible says in Psalm 133 that where brethren dwell together in unity, there the Lord commands the blessing. When you share this prayer, you are not just forwarding a message. You are becoming a distribution center of divine protection. You are becoming an agent of the kingdom, extending the realm of God's safety over territories and lives. So before we go deep, take a moment and share this. Let it go viral, not for views, but for the salvation and preservation of lives. Let the enemy be troubled that his plans of destruction are being dismantled before the sun rises over the earth. Now, let me tell you something that will shift your understanding of spiritual warfare forever. The morning is not just a time of day. It is a spiritual gateway. It is the threshold between what happened in the night and what will unfold in the day. The Bible is filled with the significance of mornings. Genesis 1 tells us that the evening and the morning were the first day, the second day, the third day, God embedded in creation a principle. Every new beginning, every fresh mercy, every divine orchestration finds its release at the breaking of day. This is why Lamentations 3:22:223 declares, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." But here is what many believers miss. While God's mercies are new every morning, the enemy also understands the strategic significance of this hour. Before you wake up, there have been assignments drafted against your day. There have been spirits commissioned to frustrate, to delay, to afflict, to confuse. The morning is a battlefield and whoever takes dominion over it controls the narrative of that day. This is why Job would rise early and offer sacrifices for his children. Job 1:5 says, "And it was so when the days of their feasting were gone about that job sent and sanctified them and rose up early in the morning [music] and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all." Job understood that the morning was not just for coffee and newspapers. It was for altars, for intercession, for covering. When you cover your morning with God's protection, you are not being religious. You are being strategic. You are engaging in spiritual intelligence. You are saying to the powers of darkness before you execute any agenda, I have consulted with the most high. I have received my mandate. I have activated my immunity. I have released the blood of Jesus over every gate of my life. And when you [music] do this consistently, you will begin to notice a pattern. Things that used to trouble you will lose their power. Arrows that used to find you will miss their target. Traps that were set in your path will collapse before you arrive. I pray in the name of Jesus that every person listening to me right now from this moment forward, you will never walk into any day without the conscious awareness that you are covered by the God of heaven. I decree that your mornings will become altars of divine encounter. I prophesy that as you learn to sanctify your mornings, you will begin to see the hand of God move in ways that will make you a living testimony. Receive it in Jesus's mighty name. Now, the Bible gives us a picture of what happens when the morning is properly covered. In Exodus 14, the children of Israel [music] were trapped between the Red Sea and Pharaoh's army. All night long the pillar of cloud stood between them and their enemies. But watch this. Exodus 14:24 says, "And it came to pass that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the [music] Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud and troubled the host of the Egyptians." The morning watch. It was in the morning that God confused the enemy. It was in the morning that the wheels of their chariots were taken off. It was in the morning that the Lord fought for Israel. There is something about the morning watch that attracts the intervention of God. When you prioritize God in the morning, you are inviting him to look upon your situation through the pillar of fire and cloud. You are summoning his attention to the hosts that have gathered against you. And when the Lord looks so when Jehovah turns his gaze toward your adversaries, they become troubled. Their confidence crumbles. Their weapons malfunction, their strategies backfire. This is why Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David was a warrior. He fought lions. He fought bears. He fought giants. He fought armies. But before David went to any battlefield, he went to the altar. In the morning, he directed his prayer. He didn't just pray randomly. He directed it. He aimed it. He targeted specific areas of his life and [music] said, "Lord, this is where I need you today. This is the door I need you to guard. This is the assignment I need you to frustrate." And I want to submit to you that many people are losing battles they should have won simply because they did not cover their morning. They woke up and immediately grabbed their phones. They scroll through social media. They read the news. They allow the energy of the word to set the tone for their day before they consulted with God. And by the time they remember to pray, the enemy has already gained access. The atmosphere is already contaminated. The day is already under siege. But today we are turning that narrative around. Today we are going back to the ancient parts where the good way is. Today we are reestablishing the morning altar. And I decree that from this day forward the first voice you will hear in the spirit will be the voice of the Lord. The first atmosphere you will create in your day will be the atmosphere [music] of heaven. The first agenda you will submit to will be the agenda of the kingdom. Let me pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne with holy hands and a consecrated heart. I thank you because you are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. You have been watching over your children even while they were unconscious in their beds. And now Lord, as we rise to face a new day, we acknowledge that without you, we can do nothing. We declare that this morning belongs to you, every second, every minute, every hour is under your jurisdiction. We cover this day with the blood of Jesus. We release the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume every plan of the enemy. We decree that no weapon formed against us shall prosper [music] and every tongue that rises against us in judgment we condemn. This is our heritage as servants of the Lord and our righteousness is of you in Jesus's mighty name. Now I want you to understand the anatomy of divine protection. Protection is not passive. It is active. The Bible uses different terminologies to describe the protective mechanisms of God. In Psalm 91, which is the ultimate prayer for protection, we see layers of divine covering. Verse one says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty." The secret place is a position of intimacy. The shadow is a position of proximity. You cannot be under the shadow of a person you are far from. This tells us that protection is a [music] function of relationship. Then verse four says, he shall cover thee with his feathers and under his wings shalt thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Feathers speak of tenderness. Wings speak of covering. Shield and buckler speak of military defense. God's protection is both gentle and fierce. It is nurturing and militant. It is a mother's embrace and a warrior's armor. This is the kind of protection we're invoking this morning. Comprehensive, multi-dimensional, all encompassing. When you cover your morning with God's protection, you are activating Psalm 91 to 1112. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall be thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. Angels are real. They are not symbolic. They are not metaphorical. They are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who are heirs of salvation. And when you pray in the morning, you are giving angels the assignment for the day. You are dispatching them to the roots you will travel, the meetings you will attend, the transactions you will make. I have seen this work in my own life. There have been mornings when the Holy Spirit would prompt me to pray very specifically about a journey and later in the day I would hear testimonies of accidents that happened on that same route at the exact time I would have been there but I was delayed or redirected. That is not luck. That is not coincidence. That is the result of a morning that was covered in prayer. That is what happens when angels are activated on your behalf. In the name of Jesus, I decree angelic protection over your life. I release the angels of the Lord to surround you as you go out and as you come in. I declare that they will keep watch over your sleep and your waking. They will monitor your words and your steps. They will shield you from sin and unseen dangers. Every pit the enemy has dug for you, the angels will cover it before you get there. Every trap the enemy has set, the angels will dismantle it before you arrive. You will not be a victim of wrong place, wrong time. You will not fall into ambushes. You will not be caught off guard. The Lord will keep you in all your ways in Jesus name. Now the Bible also teaches us about the power of declaration in the morning. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your tongue is a weapon. Your words are seeds. What you say in the morning sets the atmosphere for your day. This is why you must be intentional about what comes out of your mouth when you wake up. Don't wake up complaining. Don't wake up murmuring. Don't wake up speaking fear and doubt. Wake up declaring the word of God. Wake up prophesying over your life. Wake up calling those things that be not as though they were. Job 22:28 says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." A decree is not a request. It is an authoritative statement. It is a legal pronouncement. When you decree something, you are not asking permission. You are enforcing a verdict that has already been passed in the courts [music] of heaven. And the Bible says when you decree it shall be established. Not it might be established. Not it could be established. It shall be established. So this morning I want you to open your mouth and decree. Say I decree that this day is blessed. I decree that favor surrounds me like a shield. I decree that the Lord makes all grace abound toward me. that I always having all sufficiency in all things may have an abundance for every good [music] work. I decree that I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. I decree that no evil shall befall me, neither shall any plague come near my dwelling. I decree that the Lord perfects everything that concerns me. His mercy endures forever and he will not forsake the works of his own hands. Can somebody say amen? You see, when you make these declarations, you are not being presumptuous. You are not being arrogant. You are simply agreeing with what God has already said about you in his word. You are aligning your mouth with heaven's constitution. You are speaking God's will into manifestation. And the Bible is clear. Heaven and earth will pass away, but the word of God will never pass away. So when you speak the word, you are releasing something that is eternal, something that is irrevocable, something that cannot be cancelled by any power in the universe. I prophesy over your life that your mouth will become a fountain of life. I decree that your declarations will carry prophetic weight. I declare that what you say in the morning will frame your world. The enemy will hear your voice and retreat. Circumstances will hear your voice and align. Doors will hear your voice and open. Mountains will hear your voice and move. Let the prophetic anointing rest upon your tongue in Jesus's mighty name. But let me also warn you about something. Covering your morning with God's protection is not a one-time event. It is a lifestyle. It is not something you do when you remember or when you feel like it. It is a discipline. It is a covenant. The enemy is consistent. He wakes up early to plot. He stays up late to strategize. If you are going to defeat him, you must be more disciplined than he is. You must be more consistent than he is. You must be more intentional than he is. Daniel understood this. Daniel 6:10 says, "Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem. He kneelled upon his knees three times a day and prayed and gave thanks before his God. As he did a four time. Notice that phrase, as he did a four time. Daniel's prayer life was not reactive. It was routine. [music] It was not occasional. It was habitual. Even when there was a decree that anyone who prays to any god except the king would be thrown into the lion's den, Daniel did not change his kadu. He prayed as he always did. And what was the result? The lion's mouths were shut. The king was convicted. The enemies were destroyed. Daniel was promoted. All because he refused to compromise his altar. All because he maintained his consistency. All because he covered his mornings, his afternoons, and his evenings [music] with prayer. I want to challenge you today. Make a covenant with God that you will not leave your room in the morning without praying. Make a decision that no matter how busy your schedule is, no matter how late you stayed up the night before, you will create time to seek the face of God when you wake up. It doesn't have to be hours, even 15 minutes of focus, fervent, faithfilled prayer can shift the atmosphere and set the tone for your entire day. And watch what will happen. Your life will become an enigma. People will wonder why things that trouble others don't trouble you. They will ask why you have peace in the midst of chaos. They will be amazed at how doors open for you. They will be shocked at how you escape dangers. And you will know that it is not by your power, not by your might, but by the spirit of the Lord. It is because you have a secret you cover your mornings with God's protection. Let me take you to another dimension of this truth. The Bible talks about the morning star. Revelation 22:16 says, "I, Jesus, have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David and the bright and morning [music] star." Jesus identifies himself as the morning star. A morning star is a star that appears just before dawn, announcing that a new day is about to break. It is a herald of light in the midst of darkness. When you cover your morning with the presence of Jesus, you are inviting the morning star himself to arise [music] in your heart. You are inviting him to dispel every darkness, you are inviting him to announce to your spirit that no matter what happened yesterday, today is a new day. No matter how dark the night was, the light is coming. No matter how heavy the burden was, the joy of the Lord is about to manifest. And I decree that as you embrace this truth. Jesus, the bright and morning star will arise upon you, every shadow of depression, I command it to flee, every cloud of confusion, I command it to dissipate. Every weight of discouragement, I command it to lift. The light of God is breaking forth in your life. The glory of the Lord is rising upon you. You will not walk in darkness. You will not grope at noonday. the path of the justice as a shining light that shines brighter and brighter onto the perfect day. Receive it in Jesus name. Now I want to address something that the Holy Spirit is highlighting to me. Some of you have been experiencing what I call morning afflictions. You wake up with heaviness. You wake up with unexplained anxiety. You wake up with physical pain that the doctors cannot diagnose. You wake up with oppressive thoughts. You wake up feeling like you didn't sleep at all even though you were in bed for hours. Let me tell you what is happening. The enemy has been attacking you in the night season and the effects are manifesting when you wake up. The Bible talks about the terror by night and the arrow that flies by day. Psalm 91:5-6 says, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday. There are spirits that operate specifically in the [music] night. They afflict people in their dreams. They oppress people in their sleep. They plant things in the subconscious that manifest as morning heaviness. But I have good news for you. When you cover your morning with God's protection, you are not just protecting the day ahead. You are also breaking [music] the effects of what happened in the night. You are cancelling every satanic deposit. You are reversing every demonic manipulation. You are destroying every witchcraft altar that was raised against you while you slept. Right now in the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of night affliction. I come against every incubous and succubus spirit. I come against every spirit of nightmare and night terror. I command the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume. Every evil plantation that was deposited in the night season. Every evil dream, I cancel it. Every evil voice that spoke in the night, I silence it. Every evil touch, I nullify it. Every evil covenant that was initiated in the dream, I break it by the blood of Jesus. I decree that when you wake up in the morning, you will wake up refreshed. You will wake up strong. You will wake up with clarity. You will wake up with joy. The effects of the night will not spill over into your day. You are free in Jesus's mighty name. Furthermore, I want you to understand that when you cover your morning with God's protection, [music] you are also protecting your household. The Bible says in Joshua 24:15, "But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." You are not just an individual. You are a priest in your home. You are a watchman over your family. When you pray in the morning, you are creating a hedge around everyone under your roof. I have discovered that the enemy often targets families through the weakest link. He looks for the child who is rebellious, the spouse who is prayerless, the relative who is backsliding and he uses that person as an entry point to bring trouble to the entire household. But when you stand in the gap, when you take your place as a covering priest, you shut that door. You become a shield for your family. You become a firewall against the enemy's devices. In the name of Jesus, I decree protection over your household. I cover your spouse with the blood of Jesus. I cover your children with the blood of Jesus. I cover your parents with the blood of Jesus. I cover every member of your family both near and far with the blood of Jesus. I decree that the destroyer will pass over your house. I decree that the enemy will not find any access point. I decree that your home is a fortress, a sanctuary, a dwelling place of the most high. Every evil eye monitoring your family, I command it to go blind. Every evil tongue speaking against your household, I command it to be silenced. Every evil hand stretched against your loved ones, I command it to wither. Your family is covered. Your family is protected. Your family is sealed by the blood of the lamb. Now, let me bring this to a practical dimension. How do you actually cover your morning with God's protection? Let me give you a framework not as a ritual but as a guide that you can adapt to your own walk with God. First begin with worship. When you wake up before you do anything else, lift your voice and worship the Lord. Psalm 63:1 says, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is." Worship shifts the atmosphere. It enthrons God. It dethrones the enemy. It opens heaven. When you worship, you are not just singing. You are creating an environment where the presence of God can [music] manifest. Second, declare the word. Speak scriptures over your life. Personalize them. Make them yours. Don't just read the Bible like a newspaper. Speak it like a weapon. Romans 10:17 says, "So then, faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God." When you speak the word, you are building your faith. You are programming your spirit. You are establishing the truth in your heart. Third, pray in the spirit. Romans 8:26 says, "Likewise, the spirit also helpeth our infirmities, for we know not what we should pray for as we ought, but the spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered." There are things you need that you don't even know you need. There are dangers you are not aware of. There are blessings that are beyond your vocabulary. When you pray in tongues, the Holy Spirit takes over. He prays the perfect will of God for your life. He intercedes according to the mind of God. Four, make specific prayers. Ask the Holy Spirit to show you areas that need special attention that day. Is it your health? Is it your finances? Is it your relationships? Is it your ministry? Is it your business? Target those areas with focused prayer. Command the blessing of the Lord upon them. Bind every opposing force. [music] Lose the power of God. Fifth, give thanks. 1 Thessalonians 5:18 says, "In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you." Thanksgiving is a weapon. It silences the enemy. It activates the blessing of God. It opens doors that prayer alone cannot open. before you step out of your prayer time, thank God for what he has done, what he's doing, and what he's about to do. And I decree that as you implement these principles, your mornings will never be [music] the same again. You will begin to experience the manifest presence of God in ways you have never experienced [music] before. You will begin to see answers to prayers you have been praying for years. You will begin to walk in a dimension of authority and power that will [music] make demons tremble. Your life will become a testimony of God's faithfulness. Let me also address those who say, "But I am not a morning person. I struggle to wake up early. I am always rushing." Let me tell you the truth. In love, if you can wake up for your job, if you can wake up for your business, if you can wake up for an appointment that is important to you, you can wake up for God. It is a matter of priority. It is a matter of value. What you consider important, [music] you will make time for. And let me prophesy to you, the moment you make God your priority in the morning, he will become your priority throughout the day. He will order your steps, he will direct your paths. He will make a way where there is no way. You will find that you actually accomplish more in less time because the blessing of the Lord is upon your day. You will discover that things that used to take you hours now take you minutes because the hand of God is upon your life. I decree acceleration over your life. I decree that time will bow to you. I decree that you will redeem the time because the days are evil. I decree that you will operate in the realm of the supernatural where 5 minutes with God will produce more results than 5 hours of human effort. You will not be a victim of time. You will be a master of time. You will finish strong. You will fulfill your destiny. You will complete your assignment in Jesus mighty name. Now, as we begin to bring this to a close, I want to pray a militant prayer. [music] I want to cover your morning with the fire of God. I want to seal you with the blood of Jesus. I want to release angelic hosts on your behalf. And I want you to agree with me. I want you to open your mouth and say, "Amen." I want you to lift your hands and receive what God is releasing right now. Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand in the gap for every person hearing my voice. I cover them with the blood of Jesus, from the crown of their head to the sole of their feet. I decree that no weapon formed against them shall prosper. I decree that every tongue that rises against them in judgment is condemned. I release the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume every evil agenda, every wicked plan, every demonic conspiracy. I command every arrow of darkness fired against them to backfire seven times in the name of Jesus. [music] I command every pit dug for them to swallow the diggers. I command every trap set for them to catch the trappers. I decree that they will not be victims. They will be victors. They will not be prayed. They will be predators in the spirit. They will not be defeated. They will be more than conquerors [music] through Christ who loves them. I release angels to go ahead of them and prepare the way. I release angels to stand behind them and protect their backs. [music] I release angels to surround them on every side and keep them in all their ways. I decree that they will not stumble. They will not fall. They will not be disgraced. They will not be disappointed. The Lord will uphold them with the right hand of his righteousness. I speak to their businesses, their careers, their ministries, their families. I decree supernatural increase. I decree divine favor. I decree uncommon breakthroughs. I decree that the windows of heaven are open over their lives and blessings are pouring out that there is not room enough to receive. I decree that they will lend and not borrow. They will be the head and not the tail. They will be above only and not beneath. Every satanic embgo I break it. Every demonic blockade I destroy it. Every ancestral cause I cancel it. Every generational bondage I shatter it. I decree freedom. I decree liberty. I decree deliverance. Whom the son sets free is free indeed. I speak to every organ in their bodies. I command wholeness. I command healing. I command restoration. Every infirmity I command it to leave. Every disease I command it to die. EVERY PAIN I command it to seize. By the stripes of Jesus they are healed. By the wounds of Jesus, they are made whole. They will live and not die. They will declare the works of the Lord. Their lives are hidden with Christ in God, and no evil can touch them. I decree that this day is blessed. This day is sanctified. This day is ordained by God for good and not for evil. They will walk in divine purpose. They will operate in divine wisdom. They will move in divine timing. They will experience divine connections. They will receive divine instructions. they will manifest divine results. Every door that needs to open, I command it to open in Jesus' name. Every door that needs to close, I command it to close in Jesus' name. They will not miss their moment. They will not miss their season. They will not miss their opportunity. The favor of God will announce them. The glory of God [music] will promote them. The power of God will establish them. And finally, I decree that the covering they are receiving this morning will remain upon them all day long, all night long, and into the days ahead. It is not a temporary covering. It is a permanent seal. It is not a momentary protection. It is a perpetual shield. They are marked by the blood of Jesus. They are sealed by the Holy Spirit. They belong to the kingdom of God. And no power in hell or on earth can reverse that reality. In the mighty name of Jesus, I have prayed and every believer who has received this prayer says a thunderous amen. Now go forth knowing that you are covered. Go forth knowing that you are protected. Go forth knowing that the God of heaven is watching over you. Go forth knowing that angels are encamped around you. Go forth knowing that no evil shall befall you. Go forth in the confidence that you are a child of the most high God and nothing absolutely nothing can separate you from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. This is not just a prayer. This is a prophetic decree over your life. This is not just a message. This is a divine mandate from the throne room of heaven. Receive it. Walk in it. Leave it and watch the hand of God move mightily on your behalf. Be blessed. Be covered. be victorious in Jesus mighty name.
